name: @inttegro/js-workspace
description: Inttegro hosted workflow SDKs for JavaScript frameworks

scripts.build: npm run build -w @inttegro/js && npm run build -w @inttegro/react && npm run build -w @inttegro/vue && npm run build -w @inttegro/svelte && npm run build -w @inttegro/angular && npm run verify:loader
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run verify:versions && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:packages
scripts.lint:packages: publint packages/js && publint packages/react && publint packages/vue && publint packages/svelte && publint packages/angular/dist
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @inttegro/js && npm run build -w @inttegro/js && npm run typecheck -w @inttegro/react && npm run typecheck -w @inttegro/vue && npm run typecheck -w @inttegro/svelte && npm run typecheck -w @inttegro/angular
